verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no vendor documentation of page-count or file-size limits, and nothing on long-running or async handling of very large single documents. The only hands-on report is against the story: submitting 900 pages at once through the API timed out, so the user had to split the document manually, and the Le Chat interface stopped after page 2. A /v1/batch endpoint is listed, but nothing shows it handles thousand-page or multi-gigabyte files without timeouts or truncation.
